ai.title: AI
ai.meta: AI Add-on — Agent targets, public MCP & Skills, and model providers

providers.title: AI Providers
providers.body: Mainstream presets plus Compatible (Base URL / API Key). Stored in APPDATA AI config — separate from file-system Providers. No billing panel.

mcp.title: Public MCP
mcp.body: Shared MCP catalog in APPDATA AI config. Merge-deploy writes only afm__* keys — never whole-file overwrite.

skills.title: Public Skills
skills.body: AFM-owned skill library under APPDATA. Import requires a root SKILL.md. Junction deploy is a later slice.

agents.title: Agent Targets
agents.body: Discover, enable, and customize unified Agent Targets (global/project Skills dirs and MCP paths).

harness.title: Harness / Superpower
harness.body: Explicit Project-scoped init that writes AGENTS.md (and optional SDD) into a Workspace. Not part of Core create.
